summary: First test pass for QuoteCanvas. Backend health, OCR (readable text, no-text image, invalid base64), and quote validation (422 for raw_text>500, 404 for bad ids, soft-delete, delete 404) all PASS (7/14). CRITICAL BUG: FastAPI serializes Quote responses using the Pydantic alias, so POST/GET/PATCH /api/quotes return `_id` instead of `id`. This directly breaks the frontend contract (SavedQuote.id) and manifests as history cards rendered with testID='history-card-undefined' after saving from the editor; subsequent updates/deletes of a just-saved quote also fail. Frontend UI itself is otherwise excellent: capture-permission fallback renders, bottom tabs switch correctly, history empty-state and scan button work, settings shows device id, editor canvas renders live-updates to quote/book/author, 5 templates and 3 aspect ratios switch, char counter works, save button POSTs successfully, and Export & Share on web does not crash (saves, toast suppressed by nav).

critical.issue: Response JSON contains `_id` instead of `id`. FastAPI uses response_model_by_alias=True by default, so the Pydantic alias (`_id`) is emitted. Frontend expects `id` (src/api.ts SavedQuote.id, editor.tsx setDraft({id: saved.id}), history.tsx openQuote/history-card-${item.id}). Confirmed from server response: {"_id": "6abef8b72d60156486ad7b32", ...}.

ui_bugs.issue: Saved cards render with testID='history-card-undefined' because API returns _id, not id. Tapping card won't open editor correctly and delete action keyed on undefined.

integration_issues.issue: Save POST succeeds and card appears in history, but item.id is undefined so re-open/delete flows are broken. Root cause is backend _id serialization bug above.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents to style on the wrapping <View>. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/history.tsx:173

action_items: Fix FastAPI response serialization so Quote responses emit `id` not `_id`. Simplest options: (a) add `response_model_by_alias=False` to each @api_router route decorator for /quotes endpoints, (b) switch field alias to `serialization_alias`/`validation_alias` (AliasChoices) and keep `id` as the serialized name, or (c) override to_mongo and manually return `quote.model_dump(by_alias=False)`.

After the above fix, re-run backend tests (test_create_quote, test_list_quotes_scoped_and_sorted, test_get_quote, test_patch_quote, test_delete_quote_soft_delete) and confirm history cards use testID='history-card-<real-id>' and delete works.
Minor: move pointerEvents from prop to style on the history card inner View to clear RN web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py BaseDocument uses `alias='_id'`; combined with FastAPI's default response_model_by_alias=True this leaks the Mongo key into the API. Prefer `serialization_alias` only on reads from Mongo or set `response_model_by_alias=False` on routes.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context managers (FastAPI 0.109+).
server.py: list_quotes has no pagination (hard-coded to 500); consider skip/limit query params before large user histories.
history.tsx: pointerEvents prop on View is deprecated in RN >=0.73 web; move to style.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Tests create TEST_-prefixed quotes under device_ids TEST_device_a / TEST_device_b and soft-delete them via API in teardown. Editor UI test also created one quote (test id undefined due to bug) under device dev-muq7w8cg-wwfexrj7 that remains soft-undeleted; main agent may ignore or purge via Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After backend fix for `_id` -> `id`, rerun `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_api.py -v` with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env set. For UI, re-execute the editor save flow and verify history-card testID uses the returned id and tapping it reopens the editor populated with the quote.
rca_of_issue: RCA: /app/backend/server.py defines `class BaseDocument(BaseModel)` with `id: Optional[PyObjectId] = Field(default=None, alias='_id')`. FastAPI's default behavior for response serialization is `response_model_by_alias=True`, so when `create_quote` (and friends) returns a Quote, the JSON key becomes `_id`. The frontend (src/api.ts SavedQuote and consumers in editor.tsx/history.tsx) reads `q.id`, so `.id` is undefined everywhere. Reproduction: POST /api/quotes with any valid body returns `{"_id": "...", "device_id": ..., ...}` — see test_create_quote failure output in /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Mitigation (one line each option): either `@api_router.post('/quotes', response_model=Quote, response_model_by_alias=False)` on all four /quotes endpoints, or change the Pydantic field to use `serialization_alias='id'` with `validation_alias=AliasChoices('_id','id')`.
